source_column: reduction in the child poverty rate from the 2021 Child Tax Credit
quote: Altogether, the Child Tax Credit cut the child poverty rate by 43% in 2021 (from 9.2% to 5.2%), moving 2.9 million children out of poverty (Figure 1).
note: The dashboard's own prior file cites 'Columbia CPSP 2021 (~43%)' for its restore-2021-CTC scenario (analysis/reform_scores/priors.yaml).
